nodes.label: Emobilize Project Report
nodes.rationale: Compiled on 22 October 2026 from the codebase architecture and the Graphify knowledge graph.

nodes.label: Emobilize
nodes.rationale: Modern Android app for task management and daily productivity scheduling.

nodes.label: Clean Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: The app is built entirely with Jetpack Compose and split into UI, Domain, and Data/DI so each layer has a separate responsibility.

nodes.label: Interactive Radial Menu
nodes.rationale: A gesture radial action fan opens add, update, edit, and delete without leaving the current flow.

nodes.label: Spring Animation
nodes.rationale: Spring physics keeps the radial fan responsive when it opens CRUD actions.

nodes.label: ExpandableReminderCard
nodes.rationale: The card expands and collapses, shows the E monogram, uses amber for an active reminder and red for a missed deadline, and offers Mark as done and Reschedule.

nodes.label: Reminder Option (None, At deadline, 10 minutes before, 1 hour before, 1 day before)
Notification Quick Actions (Mark as Done, Reschedule)
Design System and Theming
nodes.rationale: Standardized tokens inspired by Shadcn, Montserrat through appStyle(), and dynamic light and dark mode.

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Graphify mapped 849+ nodes and 2240+ edges, detected god nodes, and was used to confirm the dependency graph has no cycles.

nodes.label: Separation of Concerns
nodes.rationale: Work is divided along the layered architecture mapped by Graphify so each member owns one concern.

nodes.label: Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: UI state and data mutations stay reactive in TasksViewModel and AppContainer so leaf composables do not hold ad-hoc state.

nodes.label: Previews.kt
nodes.rationale: Multi-theme Compose previews (light/dark, collapsed/expanded) support visual QA in Android Studio without a full emulator.

nodes.label: Local Compile Verification
nodes.rationale: Each feature is checked with gradlew assembleDebug or compileDebugKotlin before it is merged into the working branch.

nodes.label: God Node
nodes.rationale: Graphify flags TasksViewModel, appStyle(), and AppContainer as god nodes.
